title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Role Overview and Responsibilities** 




 Dhruva Space is seeking experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to own infrastructure, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, and reliability across the organization’s product portfolio. The role will also oversee baseline database operations, security, and cloud cost management in a lean engineering environment, while mentoring the DevOps team and establishing scalable platform practices.
 



  





**Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:** 



* Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure across products.
* Own platform reliability, uptime, production deployments, and incident response.
* Manage baseline database operations, backups, disaster recovery, and performance monitoring.
* Establish and maintain production monitoring, alerting, and observability.
* Manage cloud infrastructure costs, access controls, secrets, and security posture.
* Implement infrastructure\-as\-code and standardized deployment practices.
* Manage containerized workloads using Kubernetes or similar platforms.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, documentation, and recovery procedures.
* Mentor and manage associate DevOps / platform engineers.
* Collaborate with engineering, security, and architecture teams on infrastructure and deployment requirements.
* Build scalable platform practices that support future DBA, NOC, and specialist teams.
* Support reliable infrastructure for AI/ML and agent\-based workloads where required.



  





**Candidate Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
* 8–12 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or related roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools and Infrastructure\-as\-Code, particularly Terraform or equivalent.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes/container orchestration and AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Practical knowledge of database operations, backup/DR, and performance fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, access control, secrets management, and compliance practices.
* Proven experience handling production incidents and reliability challenges.
* Ability to work as a cross\-functional infrastructure generalist in a lean engineering environment.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Experience supporting AI/ML or agent\-runtime workloads is preferred.

title: Tech S and T-Infra Automation Consultant-ISR-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) – Azure, Kubernetes \& Terraform**
**Experience:** 
 6–9 years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost\-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production\-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.


**Qualification and Certifications**
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ\-104 / AZ\-305 / AZ\-400\), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security\+).
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Exposure to GCP and broader multi\-cloud operating models.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices.


**Working Expectations**
* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams across geographies.
* Maintain clear, version\-controlled documentation for infrastructure design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts.
* Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.
* Follow enterprise delivery standards, security controls, change and operational procedures, and quality expectations.
* Provide technical mentorship and act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure, automation, and security challenges.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Infrastructure Platform Engineering (SMTS, Software Engineering)
description:
**Description**
**About the Role
   

  

 Title \- Software Engineer, SMTS \- Infrastructure Platform Engineering**
 We're looking for a strong infrastructure engineer to contribute to high\-impact modernization and cloud platform efforts at Salesforce. A core focus is supporting the migration of Tableau's legacy hypervisor and VM infrastructure into Salesforce\-managed infrastructure — owning defined workstreams (e.g., discovery, design, and delivery for a specific domain or service area) within a broader effort spanning Public Cloud, Networking, Security, SRE, and Database teams. More broadly, this role also builds and operates scalable, secure public cloud solutions (AWS, with Azure/GCP exposure) as part of the platform team.
   

  

 You'll bring solid technical depth to discovery conversations, help translate ambiguous legacy environments into concrete implementation plans for your area, and contribute to a reusable migration and platform engineering foundation that serves future acquisitions and ongoing cloud operations alike.
   

  

 You'll bring deep technical credibility to discovery conversations, translate ambiguous legacy environments into clear architectural plans, and help build a reusable migration and platform engineering foundation that serves future acquisitions and ongoing cloud operations alike.
   

  

 If you thrive in environments where the map doesn't exist yet and you have the skills to draw it, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Conduct technical discovery for a defined portion of the legacy infrastructure (e.g., a specific service or workload class within Tableau's hypervisor/VM environment), documenting findings and gaps for your area
* Partner with Public Cloud, Networking, Security, Storage, OS, and SRE teams to design and implement your piece of the target infrastructure architecture (AWS, Private Cloud, or hybrid), working from the broader architecture direction set by architects/LMTS\+ leads
* Develop and implement cloud solutions for medium\-complexity problems, designing for performance, scalability, and reliability
* Produce implementation plans for your workstream — design, effort estimates, resource needs — and deliver reliably against them
* Execute migration and modernization work for your assigned portion of the legacy VM\-based infrastructure, ensuring continuity of dependent services throughout the transition
* Build components with reusability in mind, contributing to a scalable migration framework and infrastructure model that reduces repeated engineering effort for future M\&A integrations
* Build, maintain, and deploy infrastructure as code (IaC) and modern CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment velocity
* Build automation for operations, self\-healing systems, proactive alerting, and event auto\-remediation within your area
* Collaborate across infrastructure disciplines to deliver your workstream on schedule, escalating cross\-team dependencies as needed
* Apply and help refine security and networking standards aligned with Salesforce requirements (e.g., supporting retirement of legacy auth systems)
* Participate in an on\-call rotation to ensure timely incident response, root\-cause analysis, and minimal downtime
* Document decisions, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational playbooks to support long\-term maintainability


**Coding \& Technical Depth**
 Given The Scope Of Building On AWS, Working At The Hypervisor Level, And Supporting Large\-scale File Transport, Candidates Should Be Comfortable Coding — Not Just Configuring — Across
   

  

* Infrastructure\-as\-Code \& automation: Terraform, Ansible/Puppet, and Python for tooling, orchestration, and operational scripts
* AWS SDK/API\-level development: boto3 (Python) or AWS SDK for Go/Java, to build directly against AWS APIs (EC2, VPC, S3, EBS, networking) rather than console/Terraform alone
* Hypervisor/virtualization internals: experience with VMware APIs (vSphere API/PowerCLI), KVM/libvirt, or Nitro\-based EC2 bare metal for building and operating hypervisor infrastructure including vSphere clustering, HA/DRS configuration, and storage vMotion\-level troubleshooting
* Large\-scale file transport \& data movement: experience with high\-throughput transfer protocols and services — AWS DataSync, Transfer Family, S3 multipart/accelerated transfer — for large file transport projects on AWS
* Systems\-level languages: Go or Java for performance\-sensitive, throughput\-heavy infra tooling, alongside Python for automation
* Networking\-level coding: scripting/automating routing, SDN, and network virtualization configs where hypervisor build\-out includes network virtualization
* Linux/Windows OS fundamentals: Solid Linux administration skills and working knowledge of Windows Server administration


**Mandatory Skills \& Experience**
* 6\-8\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with a strong background in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or DevOps
* Hands\-on experience with hypervisor/VM environments (VMware vSphere, ESXi, Hyper\-V, KVM, or equivalent) and/or public cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP a plus)
* Proven experience migrating on\-prem or legacy VM workloads to public or private cloud at scale by applying appropriate migration strategies (lift\-and\-shift, re\-platform, or re\-architect) based on workload constraints
* Deep understanding of networking fundamentals — VPCs, VLANs, routing, firewall rules, DNS, load balancing
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure security principles: identity management, Okta/SSO integration, zero\-trust networking, secrets management
* Proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent) and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure
* Demonstrated ability to conduct technical discovery in complex legacy environments and produce structured architecture documentation and effort decompositions
* Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycles
* Comfortable operating across multi\-disciplinary teams — able to hold detailed technical conversations with storage engineers, security architects, and SREs in the same day
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present architecture decisions and trade\-offs clearly to technical and leadership audiences
* Experience with vulnerability management — CVE triage, patch cadence, scanning tools (Qualys/Tenable/Nessus), and remediation SLAs


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience supporting SaaS or enterprise software customer environments (e.g., environment reproduction for support/troubleshooting use cases)
* Familiarity with Salesforce's infrastructure ecosystem — Trust, Public Cloud, or internal platform engineering experience is a meaningful advantage
* Prior experience with M\&A infrastructure integration or post\-acquisition platform consolidation
* Background in Storage and Database infrastructure in hybrid or multi\-cloud environments
* Containerization \& orchestration experience (Docker, Kubernetes/AWS EKS)
* Modern CI/CD \& GitOps expertise (GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Argo Workflows)
* Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, YAML, JSON)
* AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional) a plus
* VMware certification (VCP\-DCV or equivalent) preferred, or demonstrated equivalent hands\-on production experience with vSphere/ESXi environments
* Ability to break down infrastructure workstreams into milestones and communicate progress to stakeholders
* Experience prioritizing work based on risk, dependencies, and business impact in a fast\-moving delivery environment
* Familiarity with SRE/operational excellence principles — SLOs, runbooks, on\-call readiness

title: Senior API Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are looking for an API Developer who builds the platform APIs other teams depend on, and runs them in production. You will write the code in
 **TypeScript and Python** 
 , and you will own the
 **Kubernetes** 
 deployments, pipelines and monitoring that keep it running.
   

  

 These are platform APIs, so your users are other developers. That changes how you work: an API only succeeds if it is easy to adopt. We want someone who puts themselves in the user’s shoes before shipping.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Building Platform Capabilities**
* Design and build APIs in TypeScript and Python that other teams use as building blocks
* Treat other developers as your customers. Talk to them, understand how they will integrate, and design for that
* Write clear OpenAPI contracts, useful documentation and error messages that actually help the caller
* Pick sensible defaults so the common case works with minimal setup
* Keep versioning and backwards compatibility in mind, so adopting your API today does not create work for someone tomorrow


**Deployment \& Operations**
* Package services as containers and deploy them to Kubernetes, writing and maintaining your own Helm charts
* Ship through GitOps with Flux, so what is in the repository is what is running in the cluster
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for automated testing, building and release
* Configure the API layer in front of your services: routing, authentication, rate limiting and versioning
* Instrument your services with OpenTelemetry so traces, metrics and logs show you a problem before a user reports it
* Debug issues across application code, infrastructure and networking


**Working in the Team**
* Take a problem with its context and come back with a proposal. You will not be handed a solution to implement
* Review other people’s code and take review well on your own
* Work with security and operations to keep services aligned with our controls


**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Must Have**
* 3–5 years building production APIs, comfortable in both TypeScript and Python
* Good grasp of API design and OpenAPI (REST conventions, versioning, error handling, pagination)
* Real Kubernetes experience: you can debug a pod that will not start, not just deploy to a cluster someone else built
* Hands\-on with Docker and Helm
* CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions
* Familiar with authentication patterns such as OAuth2, OIDC and JWT
* Working knowledge of relational databases
* You use AI tools every day, to get up to speed on unfamiliar technology, to explore options before committing, and to move faster on routine work, while still understanding what you ship. Tell us how you use them.
* Able to work autonomously, raise questions early and own a piece of the platform end to end
* Fluent in English


**Nice to Have**
* API gateway experience such as Kong, a plus and not a requirement. We will train the right person
* GitOps tooling such as Flux or Argo CD
* OpenTelemetry and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo or similar)
* Event\-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus)
* Cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure)
* Terraform basics, enough to provision your own databases, caches and queues
* GraphQL
* Previous platform engineering or developer experience work
* Background in financial services or another regulated industry


 Mindset
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks about the developer on the other end of the API, and asks "would I want to integrate with this?" before shipping
* Enjoys building the foundations other people build on
* Is curious and self\-directed, you research what you do not know rather than waiting to be taught
* Uses AI as a normal working tool, not a novelty, and stays critical of what it gives back
* Is comfortable owning a service from the API contract through to production
* Prefers asking a good question early over guessing quietly


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

**Role Overview**

 The MAPS team provides a secure, compliant, and highly automated Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS), reducing cognitive load and abstracting away the complexity of underlying infrastructure. We operate as strategic business partners, collaborating with teams worldwide to govern, grow, and operate container solutions. If you are passionate about building scalable platforms, implementing
 **SRE and DevOps principles**

**Primary Responsibility**
* Architect, design, and engineer our global Kubernetes Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS), focusing on scalability, reliability, security, and developer experience for the MAPS product suite.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps principles to ensure high availability, performance, and resilience of the platform (e.g., defining SLIs/SLOs, managing error budgets, and streamlining incident response).

* Define and enforce best practices and golden paths for container workloads, creating clear documentation and reference implementations for our internal developer community.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for the platform, troubleshooting complex issues across infrastructure, networking, and security domains.


**Qualifications**
**Education Requirement**
* BS Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.


**Required Experience And Skills**
* Deep hands\-on expertise in architecting and managing large\-scale Kubernetes clusters (e.g., EKS, AKS, or self\-managed).
* Strong Linux background with advanced systems administration, tuning, and deep troubleshooting capabilities.
* Advanced Networking knowledge, particularly within containerized and cloud environments (VPC, subnets, routing, security groups, DNS, CNI, ingress/egress patterns).
* Strong experience with core cloud\-native technologies such as Helm, Cilium/Calico, Karpenter, and service meshes (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).

* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Shell) with a strong focus on automation.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, particularly Terraform.


**Preferred Experience And Skills**
* 8\+ years of experience in IT, with a significant focus on platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps.

* Professional certifications in Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKAD) or cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).

* Demonstrated ability to thrive in a global, matrixed, and highly concurrent environment.

description:

 With over 1\.5 million STEM and professional experts in our network across 80\+ countries, we don't just solve today's challenges. We're helping to shape the workforce of tomorrow.

 At Guidant Global India, we play our part in shaping the future of work by powering recruitment and support services for Guidant teams across APAC and wider global markets. As a strategic delivery hub and global capability centre, we partner with stakeholders worldwide to raise quality, strengthen compliance, and deliver consistently at scale.
 



 We're not standing still. We're building deeper capability in\-house, taking ownership of the work that matters most, and designing an agile, future\-ready delivery model built for where the business is heading next.
 



 Join us, and you'll be part of a people\-first team that's expert, ambitious, and collaborative, delivering A Better Way, every day.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a Data Platform Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and observability of the Headless Data Architecture (HDA), built on Databricks and Azure. You will ensure data and AI pipelines run reliably in production across multiple regions and continuously improve the platform through automation, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and cost optimization.
 



 Working at the intersection of DataOps, MLOps, and Platform Engineering, you will also help enable AI capabilities through evaluation, prompt management, guardrails, and AI\-assisted tooling.
 



 This role sits at the foundation of HFG’s ambition to become an AI\-powered Workforce\-as\-a\-Service (WaaS) organization. Your work ensures that everything built on top of the platform — from analytics and data products to AI applications — can run reliably, securely, and at scale.
 



 You will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, Platform Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and governance stakeholders to continuously improve the platform and enable the organization to make better use of data and AI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Operate and maintain the end\-to\-end HDA data and AI platform on Databricks and Azure, covering data ingestion, processing, analytics, AI, and serving layers.
* Manage and evolve Unity Catalog governance, including workspace and meta store configuration, access control, credential management, and regional data\-sharing structures.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across data and ML pipelines, driving structured incident response, root\-cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements.
* Build and maintain data ingestion and integration pipelines, including SnapLogic\-based integrations between VMS, HR systems, and the HDA.
* Implement and operate platform\-wide observability using Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring, providing both operational monitoring and strategic platform insights.
* Automate and standardize platform operations using Infrastructure\-as\-Code and Databricks deployment tooling, including compute management, job scheduling, scaling, and cost optimization.
* Contribute to the team’s AI\-accelerated engineering tooling, including the UC4 AI\-powered development workbench and supporting MCP\-based capabilities.
* Manage the AI\-platform lifecycle, including prompt versioning, model evaluation, deployment workflows, and environment promotion.
* Implement and operate AI guardrails and safety mechanisms, including input/output validation, PII protection, toxicity detection, and monitoring of AI quality and reliability.
* Work closely with Data Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, Platform Engineers, and Cloud Engineers to ensure the data and AI platform is secure, reliable, scalable, and production\-ready.
* Continuously improve platform performance, resilience, automation, and operational efficiency across regions and environments.



  





**TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Databricks in production, including cluster and compute management, job orchestration, Unity Catalog administration, Delta Live Tables / Lake flow, and production troubleshooting, workspace administration, compute policy enforcement, Databricks Apps management, and multi\-environment workspace configuration.
* Experience administering a Databricks workspace at an organizational level, including Unity Catalog metastore setup, workspace\-to\-megastore binding, catalog and schema hierarchy design, storage credential and external location management, attribute\-based access control, data lineage propagation, and Delta Sharing configuration for cross\-workspace and cross\-region data sharing.
* Experience managing Databricks compute governance, including cluster policies, instance pool configuration, autoscaling rules, spot and on\-demand compute mix, cost attribution tagging, and budget alerting through Azure Cost Management integration.
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) for deploying notebooks, jobs, pipelines, and model\-serving endpoints across development, staging, and production environments, including bundle configuration, deployment targets, and integration with CI/CD tooling.
* Experience operating the Mosaic AI platform, including the AI Gateway for LLM call routing and rate limiting, Model Serving endpoint configuration and traffic management, MLflow model registry governance, and Databricks Apps deployment.
* Strong experience with Azure data platform services, including ADLS Gen2, Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), networking, Key Vault, resource management, and cost optimization.
* Experience building and operating data ingestion and integration pipelines using SnapLogic or a similar iPaaS, with a good understanding of REST, JDBC, and file\-based integrations.
* Strong understanding of Delta Lake and data engineering patterns, including ACID transactions, table optimization, streaming ingestion, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and GitOps, using technologies such as Terraform and Databricks Asset Bundles.
* Experience with CI/CD for data platforms, including GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, automated testing, deployment gates, and environment promotion.
* Experience with observability and platform reliability, including OpenTelemetry, Grafana Cloud, dashboards, alerting, and defining meaningful SLOs/SLAs.
* Strong automation skills using Python and/or Scala.
* Experience implementing data quality frameworks, such as Great Expectations or Databricks\-native data quality capabilities, including automated validation and expectation management.
* Experience with AI/ML evaluation and validation, using frameworks such as Mosaic AI Evaluation, RAGAS, or equivalent, including LLM\-as\-Judge approaches and metrics such as faithfulness, relevance, and groundedness.
* Experience managing the AI lifecycle, including prompt versioning, prompt\-to\-model binding, environment promotion, and model evaluation across development, staging, and production.

title: Manager, Engineering  (Platform Engineering)
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
 ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self\-healing, self\-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
   

  

 We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
   

  

**Work Location: Hyderabad**
**What We're Looking For...**
 ScienceLogic is hiring a hands\-on Engineering Manager to lead our Platform Engineering team in Hyderabad. This role will manage a ten\-person team responsible for the infrastructure, systems, and test automation that our SkylarOne hybrid cloud monitoring platform runs on. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India), with a dotted line to the Sr. Director of Engineering (US), and you'll sit on the India engineering leadership team. This role is ideal for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys staying close to technical decision\-making while building organizational scale. You'll provide leadership across platform modernization, reliability, and operational excellence while developing future team leaders and strengthening the team's management structure.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 ScienceLogic scored a leadership position in the “Forrester Wave” AI Observability report. We are a global, growing software company reinventing the way companies manage their hybrid cloud data and systems by driving operational and business insights from the extensive data types contained in the SkylarOne data lake with AI.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing...**
 You'll lead a ten\-person team comprised of full\-time employees and contractors, covering the following day\-to\-day:
   

  

* Owning technical direction and architecture for SkylarOne platform modernization, including OS migrations, cloud infrastructure, and system reliability.
* Managing delivery across systems engineering, DevOps/test infrastructure, and networking, staying hands\-on with design reviews, troubleshooting, and code/config review while delegating as the team grows.
* Developing future leaders within the organization and building an effective management and technical leadership structure that supports team growth and scale.
* Partnering with the QA Engineering Manager, the Solutions Engineering Manager, and India\-based Product Owners to align platform work with product and quality roadmaps.
* Owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development for direct reports.
* Representing the India platform team in planning and reviews with Mahesh Hanumanula and other US engineering leadership.
* Driving infrastructure cost optimization and rightsizing across on\-premises (VMware) and AWS environments.
* Participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and driving continuous improvement in system operations and release readiness.


**Qualities you possess...**
**Must Have**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of engineering experience, including at least 3 years leading engineering teams. People\-management experience is required for this role, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Demonstrated experience growing a team's structure, hiring into a growing org, and ideally building or mentoring a first layer of team leads.
* A hands\-on background in systems engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering: comfortable reviewing architecture, debugging production issues, and making infrastructure decisions rather than just relaying them.
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, automation, and cloud infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routing) sufficient to guide a networking specialist on the team.
* Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code practices (e.g., Terraform, Jenkins).
* Comfortable operating across a matrixed reporting structure and collaborating with stakeholders in different time zones.


**Good To Have**
* AWS experience or certification.
* Scripting or programming experience (Python, Golang, or Bash).
* Exposure to AI\-driven development practices or AI coding assistants.
* CCNA/CCNP or equivalent networking certification.
* Experience with distributed systems or large\-scale data processing environments.

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*
**About ScienceLogic**
 ScienceLogic is a leader in IT Operations Management, providing modern IT operations with actionable insights to resolve and predict problems faster in a digital, ephemeral world. Its solution sees everything across cloud and distributed architectures, contextualizes data through relationship mapping, and acts on this insight through integration and automation.

title: The Core Engineering - Payments Tech - Vice President - Hyderabad
description:
**Job Description**
 The Core Engineering
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e.g., Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm’s compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm’s liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc.; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000\+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units:
   

  

* Metrics \& Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials \& Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non\-Financial Risk \& Controls: responsible for non\-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk


**What We Do**
 At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.
   

  

 We are looking for an senior engineer who is passionate about software development, technology and building solutions to enable critical financial businesses to function and optimize their effectiveness. We need someone with the experience to build cloud based applications and has the ability to grow into leadership roles to lead a team of engineers who can deliver solutions that delight our clients.
   

  

 Payment processing has recently become one of the key areas of focus for financial services and fintech industry. It is at the center of innovation for automating and streamlining flows to meet the needs of a variety of clients across the globe.
   

  

 Our Payments Engineering team builds and supports the systems that provide a comprehensive payment solution to the firm’s needs across institutional, consumer (Marcus) and internal (treasury) clients. These systems manage the entire payment lifecycle – from initiation to execution \- of all inbound and outbound cash flows for the firm across 60 currencies spanning multiple payment electronic networks and platforms globally.
   

  

 Governing these critical flows is not a responsibility we take lightly. We, therefore, are seeking capable engineers who are up to the task of designing, building, testing, deploying and supporting these systems with a special focus on scale, resiliency and high availability. Our technology stack includes Java, Hibernate, Spring Boot, Angular, DB2, MongoDB, Oracle, GS Search (proprietary search tool), Elastic search, and Kafka, ECS, AWS cloud application developers.
   

  

 Our global team is well\-balanced in size and experience levels, enabling you to maximize your potential. We have both the senior and junior developers who will work with you, challenge you, and teach you along the way. Our engineers often blur the lines between front end, back end, DevOps, and product management, and we value developers who can cover a breadth of skills while also cultivating areas of expertise. A willingness to learn new languages, technologies and the business will be key to your success.
   

  

**How Will You Fulfill Your Potential**
* You will build and develop with a team of world\-class engineers.
* Hand on – initially more focus on delivery and show the potential to grow into a team lead.
* You will forge strong relationships with our clients in Operations, Trading and Sales as we deliver solutions that are critical to our business.
* The team you will join is a large community of like\-minded technologists in a very flat structure.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Degree in any STEM subject (or equivalent work experience).
* 5\.5 \- 8 years of experience.
* Excellent technical, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with proven ability to build and motivate a team.
* Experienced stakeholder manager.
* Professional experience coding in Java.
* Cloud development – AWS


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Degree in computer science.
* Experience working in financial services industry.
* Experience with payment systems.
* Experience with database technologies.
* AWS Certified Developer – Associate


**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**
 At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.
   

  

 Engineering is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here!

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**About the Role** 




 LivSYT is building an AI\-native engineering platform that automates complex infrastructure design \- from engineering calculations and 3D/CAD models to drawings and downstream project workflows.
 



 We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build the platform layer connecting our CAD/geometry engine, AI systems and cloud infrastructure.
 **This is not a conventional CRUD/API development role.** 
 You will work on large engineering models, distributed computation, real\-time collaboration, versioning, multi\-user concurrency and secure enterprise deployments. You will have significant ownership over architecture and technical decisions as the platform scales globally.
 



  
 



**What You Will Own** 



* Design and build high\-performance backend services using Python, FastAPI and asynchronous programming.
* Architect APIs and distributed services connecting CAD/geometry engines, AI agents and cloud services.
* Build systems for processing and managing large engineering/CAD models and binary files, including DWG, IFC and BREP workflows.
* Design real\-time multi\-user collaboration: concurrency, versioning, locking, conflict resolution and recovery.
* Build event\-driven and asynchronous workflows using Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS or equivalent systems.
* Design scalable data architectures using PostgreSQL, Redis and object storage such as S3\.
* Own performance, observability, reliability and production troubleshooting for cloud\-native services on AWS.
* Design secure multi\-tenant architecture including RBAC/ABAC, auditability, encryption and enterprise data isolation.
* Build and improve CI/CD for backend services using Git, Docker and modern deployment pipelines.
* Work directly with CAD, AI, frontend and product engineers to take systems from architecture through production.



  
 



**What We Are Looking For** 




**Must have** 



* 7\+ years building production backend or platform systems.
* Excellent Python fundamentals and production experience with FastAPI, Django, Flask or another modern Python backend framework.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency, distributed systems and service\-oriented architecture.
* Strong PostgreSQL fundamentals: schema design, transactions, indexing and query optimization.
* Experience with event/message systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS.
* Production experience with AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker and CI/CD.
* Strong system\-design ability and experience diagnosing performance, scalability and reliability problems in production.
* Evidence of owning systems end\-to\-end \- not only implementing tickets.



**Strong advantage** 



* Experience with large\-file or binary\-data processing.
* WebSockets, collaborative editing, distributed locking, version\-control or other real\-time systems.
* Kubernetes, ECS or EKS and production observability tooling.
* CAD, GIS, gaming engines, simulation, geometry or 3D systems.
* AI/LLM infrastructure, agent integration or model\-serving workflows.
* Enterprise multi\-tenant SaaS, permissions, security and audit systems.



**The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here** 



* You enjoy hard systems problems and can move between architecture, code, debugging and production.
* You make pragmatic trade\-offs between speed, scalability and engineering quality.
* You can challenge an architecture constructively and then take ownership of the solution.
* You are comfortable working closely with domain engineers, product leaders and other senior engineers.
* You want to build core technology rather than maintain a mature legacy platform.



**Why LivSYT**

**About GHX**
 GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the GHX Global Network — the world’s largest cloud\-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate key processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. Its solutions span electronic trading, procurement automation, inventory and contract management, business intelligence, and data synchronization, helping healthcare organizations improve productivity and focus more on patient care. Over the years, GHX has enabled significant cost savings for the industry and continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI\-driven capabilities.
   

  

 Website: https://www.ghx.com/
   

  

 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ghx/
   

  

**About The Role**
 GHX is seeking a hands\-on Engineering Manager with expertise in software engineering, release management, artificial intelligence and cross\-functional collaboration. The work blends modern software practices with pragmatic AI to reduce manual exceptions, improve matching accuracy, and enhance the invoice processing end\-to\-end.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Engineering Leadership
   

  

* Provide technical and people leadership for an engineering team.
* Manage, mentor, and grow a high\-performing team of software engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability.
* Partner with other engineering and cross‑functional leads to align priorities and ensure cohesive execution.
* Coordinate incident response for the team, including coverage and technical response to issue.


 Hands‑on Technical Leader
   

  

* Contribute to high‑impact coding when it adds meaningful value (foundational components, prototypes, critical paths).
* Help decompose and modernize systems where valuable, encouraging reliable, observable, and maintainable designs.
* Maintain a strong emphasis on unit and component testing as part of day‑to‑day engineering
* Work with QA team members to shape testing approaches across the lifecycle, including automation and release readiness
* Encourage shift‑left practices and CI‑integrated test suites for confidence and speed


 AI Utilization in SDLC
   

  

* Use AI during various stages of SDLC for code generation, code analysis, testing and review impact of changes
* Implement agents/skills with the vetted AI tools to produce secure, maintainable, practical solutions
* Collaborate with data and analytics partners to responsibly operationalize models where appropriate


 Technical Execution
   

  

* Conduct sprint ceremonies and ensure proper grooming of all epics/stories
* Guide the planning, prioritization, and delivery with a focus on predictable outcomes
* Establish robust monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to maintain system reliability and performance.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Plan and execute the timely release process for deliverables with all stakeholders including necessary communication.
* Champion the adoption and optimization of modern CI/CD pipelines to streamline development, testing, and deployment processes.
* Collaborate with Security team to resolve any findings and conduct the annual compliance reviews


**Qualifications**
* Education: Computer Science or related degree, or a combination of education and related experience.
* Experience:
* 8\+ years of prior software development experience with hands\-on coding and management experience.
* Deep understanding of modern CI/CD pipelines, including tools like Bamboo or GitHub Actions.
* Proficiency with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, etc) and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, Docker).
* Experience with Agile development processes (Scrum, Kanban) and leading teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong focus on quality assurance with proven expertise of delivering high\-quality software.
* Applied knowledge of AI in day‑to‑day engineering and process automation.


**Technical Skills**
* Experience with development languages such as Java, Springboot, Node.js
* Familiarity with frontend frameworks, including Angular (12\+) and strong proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript
* Proficiency with AWS cloud and cloud‑native services
* Practical experience with Relational and NoSQL databases, such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or cloud‑native data stores.
* Proficiency with CI/CD and infrastructure automation tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Bamboo).
* Knowledge of Testing tools like Selenium, Playwright, Postman or similar
* Familiarity with AI‑powered engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to enhance development velocity and code reliability.


**Soft Skills**
* History of handling multiple concurrent projects
* Ability to effectively communicate across organizational levels and with a variety of stakeholders, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Strong strategic thinking that prioritizes long term outcomes over emergent distractions.
* Ability to make difficult decisions and to drive decisions into actuality
* Ability to understand and effectively explain up and downstream product, team, and organizational impacts
* Ability to constructively challenge the status quo and to iterate and improve across multiple business domains
* Leadership and mentoring skills including the ability to lead by example, promoting a common purpose and serving as a catalyst for success
* Demonstrate emotional maturity and a positive outlook.
* Demonstrated analytical, organizational, prioritization, and time management skills


**GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare**
 Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
   

  

 GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud\-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe \- who rely on smart, secure healthcare\-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.
   

  

 It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce \- not shift \- the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
   

  

 We are seeking a skilled and proactive Network Engineer to design, implement, and maintain our network infrastructure. This role includes managing virtual and physical network environments, ensuring optimal performance, security, and reliability across all systems. This position will also oversee the physical connectivity of our office location in Hyderabad, including cabling, hardware setup, and on\-site troubleshooting.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement network constructs to achieve business outcomes (e.g., B2B connectivity, internet connectivity, third party connectivity, etc.)

* Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure high availability

* Office cabling (Ethernet, fiber, patch panels)
* Network closets and racks
* Physical setup and relocation of network devices
* Coordinate with vendors and contractors for structured cabling and hardware installations
* Perform regular network maintenance and upgrades
* Implement and enforce network security protocols and policies
* Provide Level 3 escalation support for network\-related issues
* Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations and physical layouts

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Proven experience as a Network Engineer or similar role
* Strong understanding of network protocols and services (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DHCP, DNS, 802\.1x, IPSec etc.)
* Experience with physical network infrastructure and structured cabling
* Demonstrable familiarity with Cisco internetworking solutions
* Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills

* Demonstrable network automation experience

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities, and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 Data Infrastructure \& Strategic Initiatives team is responsible for all the automation aspects of testing processes, ensuring quality of data and independent testing of corporate \& business level process and regulatory controls by providing seamless access to the appropriate data \& platforms required to execute the associated portfolio of tests.
   

  

 A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as “An independent point\-in\-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre\-defined pass/fail criteria.” Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite. Please note: This is not an application/software testing or application/software development role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an SME, drive sustainable automation in EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) test design, development, and implementation using a modern infrastructure and thoughtfully\-designed solutions. Additionally, train/mentor the Test Automation team and help with creating dashboards for the reporting purposes.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Developing testing automation that provides timely, useful, and actionable independent insight on the operational health of Bank of America’s processes.
* Work closely with process owners in the Front\-Line Units and Control Functions (FLUs/CFs) to obtain an understanding of their processes, including underlying data, flows, and controls, and to identify risks to successful execution, so that appropriate testing and monitoring can be developed.
* The processes to be assessed span across multiple Products, Regulations and Enterprise Processes. The outputs of the methodologies will be used to drive process improvements and timely detection and reporting of errors.
* The role requires being able to document and verbally explain the intuition and details behind the methodologies in a manner that is clear, concise, and consumable for a broad set of audiences that include key stakeholders across the Bank, as well as auditors and regulators.
* The Test Tools and Automation SME will then convert the test requirements into automated tests via Python and SQL.
* Enabling automatic test document generation from code
* Use programming skills and knowledge of software development lifecycle principles
* Design and develop and implement models and tests
* Produce clear, concise and repeatable technical documentation for models and/or tests
* Responsible for creating and revising code for data retrieval/manipulation when needed
* Responsible for securing testing data that meets the needs / supports given test design
* Independently gather test scripting and data requirements and work with data partners to ensure appropriate test design and sampling requirements are incorporated into the Test Plans
* Collaborate with key stakeholders across the Bank to understand modeling and testing business processes and requirements
* Perform debugging and code reviews to ensure quality of code.
* Ensure accuracy and quality development and hold validation session with the stakeholders to get a sign\-off .
* Ensure adherence to the SLA’s / Metrics – productivity, turnaround\-time and accuracy.
* Communicate regularly with management and other support colleagues.
* Manage stakeholders with respect to business deliverables.
* Drive projects independently and ensure timely deliverables.
* Train/Mentor the team in case of any issues


**Requirements:**
**Experience : 8 \- 10 yrs**
**Education** 
 :
   

  

* Graduates or Post\-Graduates in Computer Science, Software Engineering B.Tech/B.E./M.C.A
* Certifications If Any


**Foundational Skills**
* Hands\-on experience on Python/Sql programming
* Software engineering: modular code, software lifecycle processes, unit testing, regression testing
* Strong Programming skills (e.g., Python) and solid understanding of Software Development Life cycle principle
* Advanced knowledge of data warehouse and mining concepts and baseline understanding of SQL query language and syntax
* Big data: distributed computing paradigms (e.g., mapreduce, dataframes, etc), optimizing distributed software
* Well versed with object\-oriented or functional software development concepts
* Experience using large data tooling including Hadoop and S3 as well as Spark and Trino
* Good understanding of software testing methodologies
* Worked on varied data problems; structured/unstructured and small/large.
* Applies critical thinking and connects the dots on how processes relate to one another
* Demonstrates understanding of and passion for the “why”
* Looks around the corner, explores uncharted territories with an “outside\-in” perspective
* Life\-long learner who not only assertively educates self but encourages others to learn and grow.

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**
* Own transition planning and service readiness for new or enhanced applications moving into production support.
* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.
* Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Programming in MS Visual C\#, Dot Net Framework
* Programming in RESTful API
* Coding SQL for Sql Server


**Software Engineering Processes**
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to lead delivery planning, sprint or milestone tracking, dependency management, issue resolution, and delivery governance.
* Experience establishing or enforcing engineering practices, documentation standards, quality gates, and release readiness controls.


**Design Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, design methodologies, design patterns, and anti\-patterns.
* Ability to review architectural requirements and guide teams in developing scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical designs.
* Experience assessing technical trade\-offs, long\-term maintainability, operational impact, and business value when recommending solutions.


**Requirements Engineering**
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, prioritization, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery roadmap, and operational support model.
* Experience managing requirement changes, business expectations, scope control, and impact assessment across project delivery phases.


**Configuration \& Release Management**
* Strong knowledge of source control, configuration management, environment management, release governance, and deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating CI/CD, build automation, deployment validation, version control, and rollback planning.
* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical or complex topics clearly in business terms for management, business users, vendors, and technical teams.
* Able to prepare clear status updates, escalation notes, decision papers, meeting summaries, and management\-ready communications.


**Planning \& Organization**
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and operational demands in a dynamic environment.
* Proactively identifies risks, dependencies, constraints, and execution challenges, and drives mitigation with relevant stakeholders.
* Effective in planning, tracking, organizing, and coordinating deliverables across project phases, support activities, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Works effectively with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, vendors, business users, and technical teams.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, customer focus, business understanding, and delivery discipline.
* Builds trust through transparency, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent follow\-through on commitments.


 Supports a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and team development.
   

  

**Working Experience**
* Over 8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in application delivery, technical leadership, stakeholder management, production support, vendor coordination and team management. Prior lead or manager\-level experience is preferred.

If so, we invite you to join the PXT Case Management team within HR Experience and Technologies org.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will collaborate with senior engineers (SDE\-IIIs and L5s) to implement components of our 3\-year architecture plans while gaining deeper understanding of system design and architectural patterns. You'll be responsible for driving individual projects from design to delivery, making data\-driven decisions to balance technical debt with business needs. You will have opportunities to mentor SDE\-I engineers on coding practices and technical implementation while receiving mentorship from senior team members to grow your technical and leadership skills. You'll work closely with SDMs and PMs to break down complex requirements into executable tasks and contribute to technical discussions that shape team\-level solutions. Additionally, you'll be expected to demonstrate ownership of your work by maintaining high standards for code quality, participating in on\-call rotations, and continuously improving our operational excellence.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

* Write maintainable, well\-structured, and testable code to advance your in\-flight project and submit a code review to the team
* Design a system to solve an Amazon scale problem and present a design document to the team to build consensus on your recommended approach
* Attend a team\-level operations review meeting to understand system health and identify actions we need to take to keep the system available for our clients

**About The Team**
 PXT Case Management System (PXT CMS) is Amazon's first\-party HR case management platform, launched in 2022\. It powers HR support for more than 1\.5 million Amazonians worldwide \- corporate, operations, and everything in between. Every day the platform processes over 120,000 new cases and 700,000 updates across 23\+ HR business domains, from onboarding and leave to benefits and payroll.
   

  

 We are building the next generation of the platform: an AI\-native case orchestration system that lets HR business teams automate routine work through configurable workflows and AI agent skills, so advisors and HR partners can spend their time on the moments that need human judgment.
   

  

 We are a senior, engineering\-driven team with a strong bias for ownership, deep customer empathy, and craft. We move fast, dive deep on hard problems, and treat AI as a first\-class tool for reshaping how HR support gets delivered at Amazon scale.
